in_marathi.name: Avijay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avijay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avijay is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'avi' meaning new and 'jay' meaning victory. It is the name of the divine bird Garuda, the mount of Lord Vishnu. Avijay represents new beginnings, triumph, and the power of the divine.
